caveats: Because of the methodology many of the administrative level 2 boundaries will be as much as 100 m from the positions in the source shapefile.
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other:
Adapted from prefecture sources and P-coded by OCHA.  Feature name translations by OCHA.
Hundreds of polygons in the source files covering parts of the surrounding water were removed by OCHA.
The administrative level 2 (city, town, or village) shapefile was created by dissolving a working set of overlapping administrative level 3 shapefiles to make level 2 and then consolidated with the ArcGIS ‘integrate’ command (100 m tolerance) that makes new compromise boundaries where input features disagree in order to establish topological integrity.
name: cod-xa-jpn
notes:
Japan administrative level 0 (country), 1 (prefecture) and 2 (city, town, or village) boundaries

This dataset was excluded from the set of administrative boundary Common Operational Datasets in 2023.
